# Security

Report vulnerabilities through private vulnerability reporting on the affected repository, not in a public issue:

- [PolicyStack](https://github.com/PolicyStack/PolicyStack/security/advisories/new)
- [PolicyStack-chart](https://github.com/PolicyStack/PolicyStack-chart/security/advisories/new)

Include the affected element or chart version, and the rendered object or values that show the problem.

Fixes land on `main` and in the next `policy-library` release. Older releases are not patched.

Vulnerabilities in OpenShift, ACM or OpenShift GitOps go to [Red Hat Product Security](https://access.redhat.com/security/team/contact).
